newsitem.title: KENYA: Red Cross visits Sudanese soldiers held by Uganda.
newsitem.headline: Red Cross visits Sudanese soldiers held by Uganda.

text.p: The International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) said on Tuesday it completed its first visits over several days to Sudanese prisoners-of-war held by Uganda.
The ICRC said its delegates visited the prisoners in the Ugandan capital Kampala.
Uganda last month said its army killed 60 Sudanese soldiers and captured more than 100 just inside northern Uganda, beating back a joint attack by the Sudanese army and Ugandan rebels.

The Ugandan army displayed what it said were 114 captured Sudanese soldiers and 16 Ugandan rebels said by state-run Ugandan radio to have fled into Uganda to escape attacks by Sudanese rebels in Sudan.

At about the same time last month, Sudan displayed several men it said were Ugandan prisoners of war captured after a battle with the Sudanese army in south Sudan. Uganda denies sending its own troops to fight alongside Sudanese rebels.
The presidents of Uganda and Sudan said after talks mediated by Kenya's president last Saturday that they had agreed to release all those held captive after clashes on their borders.
